items.name: get_default
items.signature: fn get_default<T, F>(f: F) -> T where F: FnMut(&Dispatch) -> T
items.summary: Executes a closure with a reference to this thread's current [dispatcher].

items.name: set_default
items.summary: Sets the dispatch as the default dispatch for the duration of the lifetime of the returned DefaultGuard

items.name: set_global_default
items.summary: Sets this dispatch as the global default for the duration of the entire program. Will be used as a fallback if no thread-local dispatch has been set in a thread (using `with_default`.)

items.name: with_default
items.signature: fn with_default<T>(dispatcher: &Dispatch, f: impl FnOnce() -> T) -> T
items.summary: Sets this dispatch as the default for the duration of a closure.

items.name: DefaultGuard
items.summary: A guard that resets the current default dispatcher to the prior default dispatcher when dropped.

methods.name: clone_span
methods.summary: Notifies the subscriber that a [span ID] has been cloned.

methods.name: current_span
methods.summary: Returns a type representing this subscriber's view of the current span.

methods.name: downcast_ref
methods.summary: Returns some reference to the `Subscriber` this `Dispatch` forwards to if it is of type `T`, or `None` if it isn't.

methods.name: drop_span
methods.summary: Notifies the subscriber that a [span ID] has been dropped.

methods.name: enabled
methods.summary: Returns true if a span with the specified [metadata] would be recorded.

methods.name: enter
methods.summary: Records that a span has been can_enter.

methods.name: exit
methods.summary: Records that a span has been exited.

methods.name: is
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this `Dispatch` forwards to a `Subscriber` of type `T`.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<S>(subscriber: S) -> Self where S: Subscriber + Send + Sync + 'static
methods.summary: Returns a `Dispatch` that forwards to the given [`Subscriber`].

methods.name: new_span
methods.summary: Record the construction of a new span, returning a new [ID] for the span being constructed.

methods.name: none
methods.summary: Returns a new `Dispatch` that discards events and spans.

methods.name: record
methods.summary: Record a set of values on a span.

methods.name: record_follows_from
methods.summary: Adds an indication that `span` follows from the span with the id `follows`.

methods.name: register_callsite
methods.summary: Registers a new callsite with this subscriber, returning whether or not the subscriber is interested in being notified about the callsite.

methods.name: try_close
methods.summary: Notifies the subscriber that a [span ID] has been dropped, and returns `true` if there are now 0 IDs referring to that span.

items.name: SetGlobalDefaultError
items.summary: Returned if setting the global dispatcher fails.

items.name: WeakDispatch
items.summary: `WeakDispatch` is a version of [`Dispatch`] that holds a non-owning reference to a [`Subscriber`].

methods.name: upgrade
methods.summary: Attempts to upgrade this `WeakDispatch` to a [`Dispatch`].
